desk.headline: Q3 revenue up 36.7% to a record NT$8.4bn, above estimates; nine-month net profit NT$2.72bn; no outlook given
results: Third-quarter revenue reached a record NT$8.40bn (about $264m), up 36.7% on a year ago and 13.8% on the second quarter.
September alone brought in NT$2.79bn, up 33.8% year on year.
For the nine months to September, revenue was NT$22.72bn and net profit NT$2.72bn, or NT$3.89 per share.
Nine-month gross profit was NT$4.10bn (an 18.1% margin) and operating profit NT$3.13bn.
The balance sheet showed equity of NT$26.12bn against total assets of NT$45.63bn at 30 September.

guidance.summary: The company gave no forward guidance. Its filing only lists the board-approved nine-month figures; quarterly profit and EPS for Q3 alone were not set out.

watch: Monthly revenue reports for October to December, to see whether the record Q3 pace holds.
Q3-only profit and margins once the full quarterly statements are published.
